portal_hypertension.title: A multisociety consensus statement on a new common definition and diagnostic criteria for PSVD or NCPF.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hernández-Gea V, Paradis V, Guindi M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：历史上，非肝硬化门静脉高压症使用异质性和区域特异性术语进行描述，例如特发性门静脉高压症 (IPH)、非肝硬化门静脉纤维化 (NCPF)、闭塞性门静脉病和结节性再生性门脉高压症。 临床提示：历史上，非肝硬化门静脉高压症一直使用异质性和区域特异性术语来描述，例如特发性门静脉高压症 (IPH)、非肝硬化门静脉纤维化 (NCPF)、闭塞性门静脉高压症
portal_hypertension.abstract: Non-cirrhotic portal hypertension has historically been described using heterogeneous and region-specific terminology, such as idiopathic portal hypertension (IPH), non-cirrhotic portal fibrosis (NCPF), obliterative portal venopathy, and nodular regenerative hyperplasia, leading to substantial variability in diagnosis, reporting, and international research collaboration. Differences in guideline definitions from major societies (AASLD, EASL, and APASL), together with the presence of characteristic histologic lesions in patients without clinically overt portal hypertension, have further complicated disease classification.
